envelope.description: Expose responsive admission progress across supported clients

body.title: Expose responsive admission progress across supported clients
body.summary: Wire bounded per-review worker progress/status into current MCP/RPC readers, daemon thread status, CLI surfaces and live VS Code/JetBrains review DTOs/renderers. Preserve method names, identities and artifact-review behavior; add only the approved admission-phase/diagnostic fields and rendering semantics. Component acceptance in this task uses registered real review workers and the available host-service contract, actual MCP connection classes, daemon/artifact readers and supported client DTO/renderers. Production ReviewWorkers instantiation and atomic public-route activation are deliberately deferred to t14; installed production end-to-end qualification remains mandatory in t15/t16. Do not require production cutover to accept this component task.
acceptanceChecks: Through registered real-worker component fixtures and the available host-service contract, blocked admission does not delay cached progress/status; readers report freshness, timestamps and explicit unverified state rather than fabricated completion. Production route installation is t14 acceptance.

In the registered code/design worker component, code uses scope_preparation with task:null and unknown inventory represented by numeric zero plus explicit pending/unverified admission; design uses admission phase before its accepted plan.

Actual supported client DTOs/renderers display Preparing review or technical admission failure from the component's progress projection, never successful empty scope; existing qualified/completed views still decode. Production delivery through the installed registry is verified in t14/t15.
Registered-worker controller admission-to-assignment tests establish that cached observation preserves owner authority, does not restart admission and does not allocate another execution identity.
Current vscode-plugin and jetbrains-plugin IPC field names remain aligned; deprecated insrc-ide is outside scope.

tests.name: src/daemon/threads/__tests__/review-worker-progress.test.ts: pending admission and cached progress stay responsive during blocked worker computation
vscode-plugin/src/chat/__tests__/review-worker-progress.test.ts: admission DTOs render preparing or failure without empty success
jetbrains-plugin/src/test/kotlin/ai/insors/insrc/jetbrains/review/ReviewWorkerProgressTest.kt: admission DTOs preserve unknown inventory and current review identity
